title: Tip Calculator
h1: Tip Calculator — Split Bills and Calculate Tips
seoTitle: Free Tip Calculator — Calculate Tips and Split Bills Online
description: Calculate the tip, total bill and per-person share. Optional rounding for tip, total or per person. Private browser calculation.
intro: Enter the bill, tip percentage and number of people. See the tip amount, total and what each person owes, with optional rounding.
blurb: Calculate tips and fairly split restaurant or group bills.
howItWorks: Enter the bill amount before tip.
Set the tip percentage and number of people sharing.
Choose optional rounding. Results update as you type.
examples: Split a $85 dinner with 18% tip among 3 people.
Round the total up for a cleaner per-person amount.
Use for any group meal or service where tipping is expected.

faq.q: Does this send my numbers anywhere?
faq.a: No. All math happens in your browser.
You can round the tip, the total, or each person's share to the nearest dollar for simpler cash payments.
In many regions 15–20% is common for good service. Adjust as appropriate.
